subject: NickHQ multi-server config: settings UI, auto-connect on startup
body:
NickHQ multi-server config: settings UI, auto-connect on startup

- NickHqConfig: JSON-backed server list at %APPDATA%\mRemoteNG\nickhq_servers.json
  with connectOnStartup flag; env var fallback auto-creates entry on first run
- NickHqSettingsForm: Tools → NickHQ Servers... modal dialog to add/edit/remove
  servers with Test Connection button; NickHqServerEditForm for per-server fields
- NickHqClient: updated to support multiple servers, registers sessions with all
  connected servers, polls/posts results back to originating server
- frmMain: ConnectAll() called on startup when connectOnStartup is true

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
